releasesInRange.name: v5.0.4
releasesInRange.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **experimental**:
  - Tag cache directories with CACHEDIR.TAG  -  by @lifeiscontent in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11461 [<samp>(a8ea3)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/a8ea3c8fd)
  - Support `test.ui.theme` option  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11499 [<samp>(1da66)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/1da66405d)
  - Highlight selector multiple matches in trace view  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11489 [<samp>(5abba)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/5abba1e1b)
  - Print how many tests were affected and a total when running `--changed`  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11424 [<samp>(a2336)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/a23368585)
  - Add an option to cache dependencies instead of statically parsing them  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11515 [<samp>(c0601)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/c06012ac8)
  - Add fit and zoom controls to trace viewer  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11490 [<samp>(f5dd9)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/f5dd99ed0)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Fail the run on git and location filter errors  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11430 [<samp>(30d03)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/30d0304d2)
- Enable fsModuleCache by default  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11435 [<samp>(ad208)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/ad208cc29)
- Track project files and mocks with --changed  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11432 [<samp>(b0f2b)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/b0f2b3bb9)
- Refactor caching, fix `:` in project and change the shape of `results` cache  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11453 [<samp>(9673c)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/9673c49a4)
- Keep full `$` string values when `taskTitleValueFormatTruncate` is 0  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11485 [<samp>(4f7e1)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/4f7e1799b)
- Resolve node builtins in client environments  -  by @sheremet-va in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11417 [<samp>(56b31)</samp>](https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/commit/56b319ac6)
- Fix module graph builtin externals after #11421  -  by @hi-ogawa, **Hiroshi Ogawa** and **Claude Opus 5.5** in https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11491 and https://github.com/v
